newsitem.title: FINLAND: FORECAST-Orion Jan-April profit seen down.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST-Orion Jan-April profit seen down.

text.p: A Reuters survey of analysts covering Finnish equities showed a 275 million markka median forecast for Finnish pharmaceuticals maker Orion-Yhtyma Oy's January-April profit before extraordinary items and tax.
Orion's four-month results are due on June 11 at 0900/0600 GMT.
In January-April 1996, Orion posted a profit before extraordinaries and tax of 307 million markka.
In April, Orion said it expected improving operating profits this year at four of its five divisions, while the fifth division's operating profit would remain flat.
The median of 10 analysts' forecasts for Orion's full-year 1997 profit before extras and tax was 802 million markka (mean 803 million) in a 720-890 million markka range.
In 1996, Orion's profit was 738 million markka.

Contributors to the survey were Alfred Berg, AG Private Bankers, Aktia Bank, Aros Securities, Carnegie Securities, Erik Selin, Evli Securities, FIM Securties, Merita Securities, Opstock Securities and Postipankki.
